editorial:
Imagine being a dad who loves his kids so much that he basically locks them in their room every single night. That is exactly what happens here with a king and his six daughters. You get this funny, magical vibe right from the start because the princesses are wearing out their shoes at an impossible speed. The king is losing his mind trying to figure out where they go, especially since they just lie to his face about it. It feels like a classic fairy tale come to life, and you will find yourself rooting for the brave soldier who decides to take on the challenge to win a princess's hand in marriage.

What really makes this work is the cool invisibility cloak that lets the soldier spy on the girls. The acting is charming, and the pacing keeps you interested without feeling too slow. While some of the 80s special effects look a bit dated now, the heart of the story is still great. If you are looking for a cozy night in, you should try streaming this in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best colors. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for a family movie night.
endingExplained: The soldier uses his magic cloak to follow the princesses to a secret underground kingdom where they dance all night. Once he reveals the truth to the king, the mystery is finally solved. The soldier is rewarded for his cleverness and gets to marry the princess he likes best. Everything wraps up happily with the king finally trusting his daughters and the couple starting their new life together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves classic fairy tales and royal mysteries.
